title: Senso-ji Temple
summary: Tokyo's oldest temple, founded in 645 AD, with the iconic Kaminarimon gate and a lively approach street.
access: 5-minute walk from Asakusa Station (Tokyo Metro Ginza Line)

title: Yanaka Ginza
summary: An old-town shopping street with local snacks and a relaxed, un-touristy atmosphere.
access: 7-minute walk from Nippori Station (JR Yamanote Line)

title: Tsukiji Outer Market Food Tour
summary: Fresh seafood, street food stalls, and knife shops in Tokyo's famous market district.
access: 2-minute walk from Tsukijishijo Station (Toei Oedo Line)

title: Fushimi Inari Shrine
summary: Thousands of vermilion torii gates winding up the mountain — most visitors turn back early, but the upper trail is quiet and forested.
access: 5-minute walk from Inari Station (JR Nara Line)

affiliateLinks.label: Book an Arashiyama & Fushimi Inari day tour

title: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
summary: A soaring bamboo forest path, best visited early morning before the crowds arrive.
access: 5-minute walk from Saga-Arashiyama Station (JR Sagano Line)

affiliateLinks.label: Book an Arashiyama bamboo grove tour

title: Dotonbori Food Crawl
summary: Neon signs, street food stalls, and Osaka's famous canal-side dining strip.
access: 3-minute walk from Namba Station (Osaka Metro Midosuji Line)

title: Shimokitazawa Backstreets
summary: Vintage shops and standing bars packed into narrow streets, popular with local students rather than tour groups.
access: 1-minute walk from Shimokitazawa Station (Odakyu / Keio Inokashira Lines)
